scope: Exact public-main runtime vs exact candidate runtime sources. Staged hidden Persona fixture; nine sequential volleys with the boss forced awakened for the entire sequence; 390x844 portrait emulation, DPR=2, Chromium 151, CPU throttle 1x. The forced-awake lock is QA-only. This is not a natural campaign or physical-device result.

expectedAwakenedShots.source: Measured successful additions through the native projectile emitter wrapper; an event is counted only when the hostileProjectiles array grows. Counts use the same nine sequential pattern order.

measurements.method: Three sequential, uninstrumented RAF observation repeats per runtime. Same browser binary, view/DPR/CPU throttle, state setup, and nine-pattern order; each output reports all nine volleys while awake was held at 7 for the full performance-only sequence. This is staged browser emulation; not a physical device.

instrumentedCanvasSelfBlit.method: A CanvasRenderingContext2D.drawImage wrapper timed only native-stage calls during the same nine-pattern sequence. Instrumentation adds overhead; counts and durations are directional same-browser evidence.
instrumentedCanvasSelfBlit.observation: Live boss/player whole-world grading moves to the browser compositor; the prior full-frame grayscale self-blit is removed from those modes. HUD feedback stays in a transparent sibling canvas. The remaining self-blits are unfiltered engine operations.

checks: mode exit restores the original canvas filter
player lethal path removes mood layer
terminal hidden-boss defeat removes mood layer
SVG filter definition and overlay are removed on exit

assessment.p95: Public main p95: 66.6ms, 66.7ms, 66.7ms. Candidate p95: 50.0ms, 50.1ms, 66.7ms; medians 66.7ms vs 50.1ms. Two candidate repeats are lower and one ties; three coarse browser samples do not establish a broad mobile-performance pass.
assessment.throughput: All nine patterns remain active. Native projectile-array admissions confirm 26 awakened shots on public main and 76 on the candidate (2.92x). This isolated fixture holds boss awakening for the whole sequence; it does not represent naturally timed awakenings. Candidate p95 remains far above a 16.7ms 60fps budget.
assessment.renderingCosts: The baseline self-blits the stage canvas 464 times (178 grayscale); candidate self-blits are 0. Wrapped persona-sprite drawImage calls rise from 3177 to 27729 as projectile volume increases. Thus the measured improvement is removal of expensive whole-canvas grayscale self-blits, not a reduction in all rendering work.
assessment.bitmapContactCache: Candidate repeats recorded 4,330–17,355 stable persona-shape reuses and 61–84 misses. All candidate runs reported every image decoded and zero missing contact plans; misses are shape-cache misses, not missing files.
assessment.legacyComparison: The older 9463d5 runtime is excluded from barrage-performance attribution. Movement is checked separately by tests/rc142-movement-space-browser.cjs across 55 maps, two modes, four arena edges, and three browser layouts.
assessment.cpuThrottle4x: One matched nine-pattern run measured p95 250ms baseline vs 216.7ms candidate, with 26 vs 76 native projectile admissions. Both were severe slowdowns (over-100ms intervals in every baseline frame and 411/451 candidate frames). Single-run browser emulation; no 60fps claim.

instrumentedCanvasRendering.method: Timed CanvasRenderingContext2D method wrapper attached only to the native game-stage canvas during the same nine-pattern sustained-awake sequence. Wrapper overhead affects timing; use call counts and durations as directional same-browser evidence, not uninstrumented frame timing.
instrumentedCanvasRendering.observation: The baseline makes 464 canvas self-blits, including 178 grayscale self-blits (about 2.28 seconds of wrapped drawImage calls). The candidate records zero canvas self-blits in this fixture after moving boss-only grading to the browser compositor. Candidate sprite-image draws rise with the 2.92x emitted projectile count, so the self-blit improvement is not a claim that total drawImage calls fell.

additionalCpuThrottleCheck.method: One full sustained-awake nine-pattern sequence per revision at the same 390x844/DPR2/Chromium151 setup with CPU throttling 4x. A longer test-only sequence timeout was used so both revisions could complete all nine volleys. Single pair, browser emulation only; not a physical-device measurement.
additionalCpuThrottleCheck.assessment: Candidate p95 was lower in this single matched run (216.7ms vs 250ms), but both remained far above 16.7ms and maximum intervals were about 467ms. This indicates a directional improvement over baseline under this fixture, not acceptable mobile frame pacing.
